scope: accepted nonlinear state lifecycle; no constitutive equation or Newton algorithm change

lifecycle_marker.purpose: prevent accidental persistence of a trial or unknown lifecycle state
lifecycle_marker.security_boundary: internal consistency guard, not a cryptographic authenticity claim

components.mutability: detached in trial; published only as a validated composite commit
components.acceptance_rule: finite state, compatible counters, convergence accepted by existing engine
components.rollback_rule: discard trial; previous accepted digest remains unchanged

components.owner: material-state transaction and element trial update
components.mutability: trial-local; accepted state immutable during Newton/line search/tangent probes
components.acceptance_rule: constitutive update successful and increment accepted
components.rollback_rule: discard all trial plastic strain/hardening variables
components.checkpoint_rule: serialize only with displacement and continuation state from the same accepted increment

components.mutability: existing transaction behavior preserved; WP10 does not alter contact law
components.checkpoint_rule: existing v2 typed state and topology validation; v1 history remains unproven

components.mutability: iteration-local; never evidence of accepted state until attached to accepted composite
components.acceptance_rule: residual and convergence status correspond to the candidate being committed
components.rollback_rule: discard values for rejected trial; retain rejection reason in bounded run history
components.checkpoint_rule: persist only accepted-step counters/provenance needed for safe continuation, not transient trial arrays

components.mutability: trial controller may propose changes; accepted values move atomically with state
components.rollback_rule: reject trial factor/radius but preserve explicit rejection diagnostic
components.checkpoint_rule: compact rejection log and accepted counters stored with accepted state

transaction_rules.begin_trial: detached copy of accepted state; mark TRIAL; accepted digest recorded
transaction_rules.line_search_evaluation: all candidates derive from the same accepted reference and cannot mutate accepted state
transaction_rules.commit: validate detached trial, stamp ACCEPTED, then replace accepted composite once
transaction_rules.rollback: verify accepted digest then discard trial
transaction_rules.legacy_state_migration: only if physical and constitutive compatibility are proven; schema v1 currently UNPROVEN
